title: WidthedConfidence
description: Inseparable accuracy-or-source-quality confidence object per Calibrated Spine F4/F6/K6. Every field is required; the estimate is branded and not assignable from a bare number. Consumers must hold a complete WidthedConfidence object.

estimate.description: Branded point estimate in the unit interval [0,1]. Not assignable from a bare number; must be constructed through the full WidthedConfidence shape.

n.description: Sample size or observation count used to earn this confidence estimate.

intervalWidth.description: Width of the confidence interval in the unit interval [0,1].

provenance.description: How the accuracy-axis estimate was earned or labeled: asserted (claimed), backtest (historical), seed (initial), or live (production-earned).
